## New
- Songs now use YouTube Music's own timed lyrics first, including Hindi songs in Devanagari (#1782)
- The next song's lyrics load ahead of time, so they are ready when it starts (#1782)

## Improved
- Lyrics appear much faster: sources are asked side by side, and the search stops after 9 seconds (#1782)
- Saved line-synced lyrics show at once, and word sync is looked for once a week (#1782)
- Songs with no lyrics are remembered for a week instead of asking every source on each play (#1782)

## Fixed
- KuGou, LrcLib and SimpMusic no longer show lyrics from another song or a much shorter or longer version (#1782)
- A lyrics source you pick by hand is no longer replaced automatically (#1782)
- Your sync offset now stays with each song, through a new source and Refresh (#1782)
